info.title: Website Screenshot API - Full-Page Captures, Scrolling Video & PDF Output
info.description: Capture full-page screenshots and videos of websites with advanced options like device simulation, custom code injection, cookie banner blocking, and scrollable content recording. Supports multiple output formats including PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF, MP4, GIF, and WebM. Returns a screenshot URL, timestamps, format metadata, and all echoed parameters. Returns a 400 error for an invalid or missing url, and a 408 error if the capture exceeds the configured timeout. Also supports stealth mode, GPU rendering, classic and premium proxies with country selection, timezone emulation, text captcha solving, and PDF options for paper size, orientation, page range, media type and backgrounds. A simple screenshot costs 50 credits. Options add credits on top: scrolling or video +20, classic proxy +20, premium proxy +200 (used instead of a classic proxy), GPU rendering +20, captcha solver +20. Stealth, timezone and the other options add no credits.

get.summary: Build screenshots the way real users see the web — not just what fits on the screen.
get.description:
Capture full-page screenshots and videos of websites with advanced options like device simulation, custom code injection, cookie banner blocking, and scrollable content recording.
Supports multiple output formats including JSON, image, GIF, MP4, and WebM.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL of the website to be rendered as a screenshot or other format.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Set the output format. `json` returns metadata with a hosted file URL. `image` streams the raw file bytes directly.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: json (default).

parameters.name: file_type
parameters.description: Output format. PNG (lossless, transparency), JPEG (compressed, smaller size), WebP (modern, efficient), PDF (document). For scrolling captures: MP4, GIF, WebM. Scrolling capture formats: WEBM (web-optimized), MP4 (widely compatible, default), GIF (short loops).

parameters.name: image_quality
parameters.description: Compression level for JPEG output (0-100). Lower = smaller file, higher = better quality. Only applies to JPEG.

parameters.name: omit_background
parameters.description: Replaces simple white/plain backgrounds with transparency for a cut-out effect. Only works with PNG output.

parameters.name: pdf_options[format]
parameters.description: Paper size of the PDF. Applies when file_type is PDF. Without it, width and height are used if set, otherwise the page renders as one long page: A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, Letter, Legal, Tabloid, or Ledger.

parameters.name: pdf_options[landscape]
parameters.description: Renders the PDF in landscape orientation, swapping the width and height of the paper size. Applies when file_type is PDF.

parameters.name: pdf_options[page_range]
parameters.description: Pages to keep in the PDF, as start-end, for example 1-3 or 5-5. Pages are rendered first and then trimmed. Has no effect on a single-page PDF. Applies when file_type is PDF.

parameters.name: pdf_options[media]
parameters.description: CSS media type used to render the PDF: print or screen.

parameters.name: pdf_options[print_background]
parameters.description: Includes background colors and images in the PDF. Applies when file_type is PDF.

parameters.name: result_file_name
parameters.description: Custom name for the output file. Helps with organized storage and retrieval. Note: non-unique names may overwrite existing files.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Time in seconds the render stays cached before auto-invalidation. Use higher values for static pages, lower for dynamic content. Default: 2592000 (30 days).

parameters.name: fresh
parameters.description: If `true`, bypasses cache and captures a fresh render. If `false`, returns cached version when available.

parameters.name: enable_caching
parameters.description: Stores the render in cache for reuse on subsequent identical requests.

parameters.name: destroy_screenshot
parameters.description: If `true`, screenshot/PDF is not stored on server and must be downloaded immediately.

parameters.name: fail_on_error
parameters.description: If `true`, returns an error when the target page responds with 4xx or 5xx status.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Viewport width in pixels. Simulates device screen sizes. Max: 7680.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Viewport height in pixels. Controls how much vertical area is visible. Max: 4320.

parameters.name: full_page
parameters.description: Captures the entire webpage from top to bottom, including scrollable content outside the viewport. Ideal for long-form pages.

parameters.name: thumbnail_width
parameters.description: Specifies the width of the thumbnail in pixels. Default value is 0 (meaning no specific value is set, and the screenshot is returned at its original resolution).

parameters.name: retina
parameters.description: Captures at 2x resolution for sharper, high-DPI output. Increases file size.

parameters.name: clip[x]
parameters.description: X coordinate (in pixels) for the top-left corner of the clip area. Default: null.

parameters.name: clip[y]
parameters.description: Y coordinate (in pixels) for the top-left corner of the clip area. Default: null.

parameters.name: clip[width]
parameters.description: Width of the clip area in pixels. Default: null.

parameters.name: clip[height]
parameters.description: Height of the clip area in pixels. Default: null.

parameters.name: adjust_top
parameters.description: Initial vertical scroll position in pixels before capture. Use to position mid-page content in viewport. Not supported for PDF.

parameters.name: wait_for_event
parameters.description: Controls when rendering starts based on page load lifecycle. `load` (all resources), `domcontentloaded` (HTML parsed), `networkidle` (no network activity for 500ms).

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Wait period in milliseconds before capture. Allows animations, API responses, and dynamic elements to finish rendering.

parameters.name: lazy_load
parameters.description: Automatically scrolls the page to trigger lazy-loaded images and components. Ensures complete content capture.

parameters.name: scroll_delay
parameters.description: Delay in milliseconds between scroll steps when `lazy_load` is enabled. Use higher values for heavy pages.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds for page load before aborting. Adjust for slow/heavy pages. Default: 100000 (100s).

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: CSS selector to capture a specific element. Only that element is rendered. Falls back to full page if not found. Default: empty.

parameters.name: scroll_to_element
parameters.description: Scrolls the page to bring the specified CSS selector into view before capture. Ideal for below-the-fold content. Default: empty.

parameters.name: selector_to_click
parameters.description: CSS selector for an element to click before capturing the screenshot. Useful for opening dropdowns, modals, or triggering content.

parameters.name: click_recursion
parameters.description: Number of times to click the selector (when set via `selector_to_click`).

parameters.name: blur_selector
parameters.description: CSS selectors to blur before capture. Masks sensitive data like emails, payments, or personal info. Multiple selectors supported. Default: empty.

parameters.name: remove_selector
parameters.description: CSS selectors to remove before capture. Deletes matched elements from DOM. Ideal for cleaning ads, popups, sidebars. Multiple selectors supported. Default: empty.

parameters.name: css
parameters.description: Allows injecting custom CSS code into the page before rendering. Pass the CSS code directly as a string.

parameters.name: css_url
parameters.description: Allows loading external CSS into the page. Provide a URL pointing to the CSS file.

parameters.name: js
parameters.description: Allows injecting custom JavaScript code into the page before rendering. Pass the JavaScript code directly as a string.

parameters.name: js_url
parameters.description: Allows loading external JavaScript into the page. Provide a URL pointing to the script file.

parameters.name: custom_html
parameters.description: Custom HTML to render instead of loading a URL. Overrides the url option. Use for capturing specific HTML structures or dynamic content.

parameters.name: markdown
parameters.description: Markdown to render instead of loading a URL. Works like custom_html, so you can capture a README or notes without hosting a page.

parameters.name: user_agent
parameters.description: Custom User-Agent string sent in the request headers.

parameters.name: accept_languages
parameters.description: Sets the accepted languages for the HTTP request. This is sent as the Accept-Language header.

parameters.name: dark_mode
parameters.description: When set to `true`, websites that support prefers-color-scheme: dark will render in dark mode.

parameters.name: grayscale
parameters.description: Applies a grayscale filter to the screenshot. Requires a value from 0 (no effect) to 100 (fully grayscale).

parameters.name: enable_incognito
parameters.description: Enables private/incognito browsing. Each render starts with a clean slate - no cookies, cache, or session data persisted.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Custom HTTP headers to include as key=value pairs. Use a semicolon to separate multiple headers (e.g., `key1=value1;key2=value2`).

parameters.name: cookies
parameters.description: Cookies to include in the request before rendering. Supports single or multiple cookies. Example: `cookie=value; otherCookie=otherValue;`.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Specify longitude for the browser Geolocation API. Provide a numeric value. Default: null (not set).

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Specify latitude for the browser Geolocation API. Provide a numeric value. Default: null (not set).

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone the browser uses while rendering, such as Asia/Karachi or Europe/London. Useful for clocks and localized dates.

parameters.name: block_ads
parameters.description: Blocks requests to known ad networks for cleaner, distraction-free screenshots.

parameters.name: block_chat_widgets
parameters.description: Blocks live chat popups, support bubbles, and messaging interfaces.

parameters.name: block_tracking
parameters.description: Blocks tracking scripts and analytics services for cleaner, privacy-oriented renders.

parameters.name: no_cookie_banners
parameters.description: Hides or blocks cookie consent banners and popups before capture.

parameters.name: block_js
parameters.description: Disables all JavaScript execution. Renders a static version of the page. Speeds up capture but may break dynamic content.

parameters.name: block_stylesheets
parameters.description: Blocks all stylesheets - page renders as raw HTML without visual formatting.

parameters.name: block_images
parameters.description: Blocks all image resources (jpg, png, gif, webp, svg, etc.) for faster rendering.

parameters.name: block_media
parameters.description: Blocks audio and video resources (mp3, mp4, webm, etc.) from loading.

parameters.name: block_font
parameters.description: Blocks external font files - page falls back to system defaults. Supported: woff, woff2, ttf, otf, eot.

parameters.name: block_text_track
parameters.description: Blocks subtitles and caption overlays from loading.

parameters.name: block_xhr
parameters.description: Blocks all XMLHttpRequest (AJAX) calls - prevents dynamic API-driven content.

parameters.name: block_fetch
parameters.description: Blocks all Fetch API requests - stops async data loading.

parameters.name: block_event_source
parameters.description: Blocks EventSource (SSE) connections - prevents real-time data streams.

parameters.name: block_web_socket
parameters.description: Blocks WebSocket connections - prevents real-time bidirectional communication.

parameters.name: block_manifest
parameters.description: Blocks manifest files (.json, .webmanifest) - disables PWA-related functionality.

parameters.name: block_specific_requests
parameters.description: Fine-grained blocking of specific URLs or patterns. Separate multiple rules by comma, space, or newline. Default: empty.

parameters.name: extract_text
parameters.description: Strips all HTML and returns visible text as a .txt file. Ideal for text analysis, indexing, or AI pipelines. Only with output=json.

parameters.name: extract_html
parameters.description: Returns rendered HTML as a .html file (includes JS-executed DOM). Only available with output=json.

parameters.name: extract_markdown
parameters.description: Extracts rendered page content as a structured .md (Markdown) file. Preserves headings, lists, links. Only with output=json.

parameters.name: get_image_urls
parameters.description: Extracts all image URLs from the rendered DOM and returns them in structured format. Only with output=json.

parameters.name: stealth
parameters.description: Makes the browser look like a regular visitor for pages that block automated traffic. No extra credits.

parameters.name: gpu
parameters.description: Renders the page with a GPU, including WebGL and canvas content. Adds 20 credits per request.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Allows defining a proxy for the connection. Provide a JSON string with keys: server (include port number), username, and password.

parameters.name: classic_proxy
parameters.description: Loads the page through a datacenter proxy. Adds 20 credits per request. Ignored when premium_proxy is true or a custom proxy is set.

parameters.name: premium_proxy
parameters.description: Loads the page through a residential proxy. Adds 200 credits per request. Used instead of classic_proxy.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code, such as US or DE, for the exit address of classic_proxy or premium_proxy. Ignored when you send your own proxy. Any two-letter code is sent, including one that is not listed. Classic proxy countries: BG, GE, DE, HN, MD, UA, GB, US. Premium proxy countries: AF, AL, DZ, AO, AG, AR, AM, AW, AU, AT, AZ, BS, BH, BD, BB, BY, BE, BZ, BJ, BT, BO, BQ, BA, BW, BR, BN, BG, BF, BI, CV, KH, CM, CA, KY, CF, TD, CL, CN, CO, KM, CG, CR, CI, HR, CU, CW, CY, CZ, CD, DK, DJ, DM, DO, EC, EG, SV, GQ, EE, SZ, ET, FO, FJ, FI, FR, GF, PF, GA, GM, GE, DE, GH, GI, GR, GL, GD, GP, GU, GT, GG, GN, GW, GY, HT, HN, HK, HU, IS, IN, ID, IR, IQ, IE, IL, IT, JM, JP, JE, JO, KZ, KE, XK, KW, KG, LA, LV, LB, LS, LR, LY, LT, MO, MG, MW, MY, MV, ML, MT, MQ, MR, MU, YT, MX, MD, MN, ME, MA, MZ, MM, NA, NP, NL, NC, NZ, NI, NE, NG, MK, NO, OM, PK, PS, PA, PG, PY, PE, PH, PL, PT, PR, QA, RE, RO, RU, RW, KN, LC, VC, WS, SA, SN, RS, SC, SL, SG, SK, SI, SB, SO, ZA, KR, SS, ES, LK, SD, SR, SE, CH, SY, TW, TJ, TZ, TH, TL, TG, TO, TT, TN, TR, TM, UG, UA, AE, GB, US, UY, UZ, VE, VN, YE, ZM, ZW.

parameters.name: solve_captcha
parameters.description: Solves a captcha made of text drawn in a picture, then takes the screenshot. Requires captcha_image and captcha_input. Adds 20 credits per request.

parameters.name: captcha_image
parameters.description: CSS selector of the captcha picture. Required when solve_captcha is true.

parameters.name: captcha_input
parameters.description: CSS selector of the box the answer is typed into. Required when solve_captcha is true.

parameters.name: captcha_submit
parameters.description: CSS selector of the button to click after the answer is typed.

parameters.name: captcha_error
parameters.description: CSS selector of the message shown for a wrong answer. While it is visible, the solver tries again.

parameters.name: captcha_refresh
parameters.description: CSS selector of the control that loads a new captcha picture before the next try.

parameters.name: captcha_retries
parameters.description: Number of guesses the solver makes, from 1 to 5.

parameters.name: ocr_model
parameters.description: Recognition model used by the captcha solver: mini-ocr-v1 (default) or ocr-v1.

parameters.name: scrolling_screenshot
parameters.description: Enables scrolling screenshot mode to capture a video (webm, gif, mp4) of the webpage.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: Records visible viewport only for a specified duration. Use with `duration` parameter. Ideal for dashboards and animations.

parameters.name: scroll_speed
parameters.description: Scrolling speed: fast, normal (default), or slow. Affects render time and output pacing.

parameters.name: scroll_back
parameters.description: If `true`, scrolls to bottom then back to top, creating a seamless loop.

parameters.name: start_immediately
parameters.description: Starts recording immediately without waiting for full page load.

parameters.name: multiple_scrolling
parameters.description: Captures multiple scrolling screenshots at different viewport sizes in one request. Requires the `sizes` parameter.

parameters.name: sizes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of screen sizes in the format index:WIDTHw:HEIGHTh, for example 0:1280w:720h,1:390w:844h. Required when `multiple_scrolling` is `true`.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration of scrolling action in seconds (0-60). Higher = longer video. Default: null (full page scroll).

310.description: Too Many Redirects. The target URL redirected too many times for a final page to be reached.

value.message: The target URL redirected too many times (redirect loop), so a final page could not be reached.

value.message: Your URL is incorrect
please pass correct parameters

Target address is unreachable. Please check the URL or network connectivity.

networkConnectionFailed.summary: Tunnel connection could not be established

value.message: A tunnel connection to the target could not be established. Check the URL and proxy setting.
A tunnel to the target failed. Verify the URL and proxy settings.

value.message: The request took too long to complete. Please try again later.

value.message: The target site unexpectedly closed the connection.
The target server closed the connection without returning any data.

value.message: The browser and the target website have incompatible SSL/TLS versions or ciphers.

value.message: The request could not be completed due to temporary unavailability, such as a closed browser. Retry the request.

errSocketNotConnected.summary: Target page may be down or moved

value.message: The target page may be temporarily down or may have moved permanently.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

ScreenshotResponse.description: Website screenshot response containing the screenshot URL and metadata.

screenshot.description: URL of the captured screenshot image file.

url.description: The original URL that was captured.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the screenshot was created (ISO 8601 format).

ttl.description: Time until the screenshot expires (ISO 8601 format).

file_type.description: The file type of the output.

width.description: The viewport width that was used in pixels.

height.description: The viewport height that was used in pixels.

fresh.description: Whether a fresh render was performed (`true`/`false`).

full_page.description: Whether full page capture was used (`true`/`false`).

destroy_screenshot.description: Whether the screenshot was destroyed after generation (`true`/`false`).

fail_on_error.description: Whether the request failed on error (`true`/`false`).

block_fetch.description: Whether Fetch API requests were blocked (`true`/`false`).

get_image_urls.description: Whether image URL extraction was enabled (`true`/`false`).

longitude.description: The longitude value used for geolocation.

latitude.description: The latitude value used for geolocation.

proxy.description: The proxy configuration used for the request.

headers.description: The custom headers that were included in the request.

cookies.description: The cookies that were included in the request.

scroll_to_element.description: The element that was scrolled to before rendering.

selector.description: The element that was selected for rendering.

selector_to_click.description: The CSS selector of the element that was clicked before capture.

click_recursion.description: The number of times the selector was clicked.

blur_selector.description: The elements that were blurred in the output.

remove_selector.description: The elements that were removed from the output.

css.description: The custom CSS that was injected into the page.

css_url.description: The external CSS URL that was loaded.

js.description: The custom JavaScript that was injected.

js_url.description: The external JavaScript URL that was loaded.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string that was used.

accept_languages.description: The Accept-Language header that was used.

delay.description: The delay duration that was applied in milliseconds.

thumbnail_width.description: The thumbnail width that was used in pixels.

output.description: The output type that was used.

image_quality.description: The image quality level that was applied.

timeout.description: The actual timeout duration that was applied in milliseconds.

adjust_top.description: The vertical position that was scrolled to in pixels.

wait_for_event.description: The event that triggered the rendering to start.

grayscale.description: The grayscale level that was applied (0-100).

scrolling_screenshot.description: Whether scrolling screenshot mode was enabled (`true`/`false`).

multiple_scrolling.description: Whether multiple scrolling captures were performed (`true`/`false`).

sizes.description: The dimensions used for each capture in the array.

duration.description: Duration of scrolling capture in seconds.

result_file_name.description: The final filename used for the output file.

extracted_html.description: URL of the extracted HTML from the webpage.

extracted_text.description: URL of the extracted plain text from the webpage.

custom_html.description: The custom HTML content that was rendered.

block_specific_requests.description: The specific requests that were blocked.

clip.description: The dimensions of the clipped area that was captured.

scroll_delay.description: The delay between scroll steps that was applied in milliseconds.

video.description: Whether viewport recording mode was enabled (`true`/`false`).

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.

X-Concurrent-Threads.description: Specifies the maximum number of concurrent requests allowed.

X-Concurrent-Threads-Active.description: Indicates the number of active concurrent requests being processed.
